CLOSED 2026-11-24. All five crates done, plus the core::net item that was filed as "related, verify before assuming".

## What changed

- pkix-dane: std feature DELETED. It gated nothing but the Error impl. The crate is now plainly #![no_std]. pkix-dane-resolver and pkix-chain no longer request features = ["std"] from it.
- pkix-path: Error and DerError implement core::error::Error unconditionally, source() chains included. std feature KEPT -- it forwards to der/std, spki/std, x509-cert/std.
- pkix-revocation: same. std KEPT -- forwards to der/std and pkix-path/std, and crl/ocsp depend on it.
- pkix-aia: Error impl unconditional. std KEPT, and its only remaining job is gating the IoFailure variant, whose kind: std::io::ErrorKind has no core equivalent. Comment updated to say that is now all it does.
- pkix-identity: Error impl unconditional, AND the three From<IpAddr> impls are no longer std-gated -- they use core::net (Rust 1.77), which holds the same types std::net re-exports.

## The core::net finding was worth more than expected

The bead said to verify before assuming pkix-identity could use core::net. It can, and the gain is larger than the Error impl: its From<Ipv4Addr>, From<Ipv6Addr> and From<IpAddr> conversions were ALL behind #[cfg(feature = "std")], so a no_std consumer could not construct a ServerName from an IP address type at all. IP-literal SAN matching is a normal thing to want on an embedded target. That is now available unconditionally.

## Verified, not assumed

- der 0.8 implements core::error::Error for its own Error unconditionally. Checked in the vendored source before moving pkix-path's and pkix-revocation's source() chains, since both return a DerError that wraps one.
- DaneError: core::error::Error holds with NO features enabled -- proved with a throwaway compile probe, then made permanent as a compile-time assertion in pkix-dane and pkix-aia alongside their existing non-negotiable #6 invariants, so a future cfg cannot quietly put the impl back behind a feature.
- Every core crate builds with --no-default-features: pkix-dane, pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-aia, pkix-identity, pkix-lint, pkix-profiles.
- cargo check --workspace --all-features --locked passes on the declared MSRV 1.88.
- fmt / clippy --all-targets --all-features -D warnings / rustdoc -D warnings / full test suite all pass.

## Release note

Deleting pkix-dane's std feature would be breaking for a consumer who enabled it, but the feature only ever existed in 0.2.0, which is unreleased. The published 0.1.0 stub had no features at all. So nothing downstream can be affected.

The other four changes are purely additive: an impl that was behind a feature is now unconditional, and no feature was removed.

## Acceptance

[x] pkix-dane's std feature deleted; DaneError implements Error unconditionally
[x] pkix-path and pkix-revocation implement Error unconditionally; their std features kept, with the reason being that they forward to dependencies rather than merely gating the impl
[x] pkix-aia's Error impl unconditional while std continues to gate IoFailure, comment updated
[x] pkix-chain drops features = ["std"] on its pkix-dane dependency
[x] pkix-identity on core::net -- answered yes, and done, with the From<IpAddr> gain recorded above
[x] no_std builds clean; MSRV and the full gate set pass
